correctness.rationale: Simple path eigenvalues 2Jcos(pi k/(N+1)) and sine eigenvectors vanish at site x iff N+1 divides kx. The modes invisible simultaneously to sink c and every dephased vertex form K_g of dimension g-1. To exclude further persistent density, Cesaro averaging of any positive surviving trace gives stationary PSD sigma; tracing its generator implies zero at sink and the Hilbert-Schmidt dissipation identity forces sigma to commute with each selected P_j. Commutation with H then diagonalizes sigma in the simple path eigenbasis; overlap with the strictly positive ground sine eigenvector forces zero weight at every dephased site. Thus all stationary support lies in K_g, contradiction on its complement. Root-of-unity sine sum gives captured site fraction 1 or 1-g/(N+1). Positive rates but no bulk loss essential. This is a rigorous invariant-space result, not just the finite checker log.
